name: Ingenuity Mars Helicopter
summary: Ingenuity was the first aircraft to achieve powered controlled flight on another planet.
hook: I completed 72 powered flights in the thin atmosphere of Mars before retiring in Jezero Crater.
how_it_worked: Coaxial counter-rotating carbon-fiber rotors spinning at 2,400 RPM to lift in atmospheric density under 1% of Earth.
science: Proved aerial scout capability across complex dunes and guided routes for the Perseverance rover.

facts.text: Originally designed for five demonstration flights, Ingenuity flew 72 times and logged over two hours in the air.
Carried a small swatch of fabric from the Wright brothers 1903 Flyer underneath its solar panel.

image.alt: Close-up of the Ingenuity Mars Helicopter on the Martian surface, taken by the Mastcam-Z cameras on the Perseverance rover
